title: NERC BAL-001-TRE-2 Frequency Nadir Rule (planning note)
summary: Under-frequency load shedding stages and BESS fast-frequency-response obligations used for grounding checks.
content: Stage 1 UFLS at 49.5 Hz sheds 5% of regional load. Utility BESS must inject rated active power within 500 ms of frequency falling below 49.90 Hz (IEEE 1547-2018 Category III) and must cease charging immediately. Sustained operation below 49.5 Hz for more than 30 seconds requires operator notification and staged demand-response dispatch before any market export is scheduled.
